blocks.text: Strategy Design Pattern mukhtalif tools (auzaron) se bhare dabbe (toolbox) jaisa hai, jis mein har tool ek khaas kaam ke liye bana hai. Jab koi masla aaye to aap kaam ke mutabiq dabbe se theek tool chun lete hain. Yani masla hal karne ke “kai tareeqe” hote hain aur aap baqi cheezein zyada badle baghair un mein aasani se badal sakte hain.
Apne aas paas ki asal zindagi ki koi soorat pehchanein jahan in design patterns mein se koi ek lagaya ja sake. Apni misalein agli class mein share karein.

blocks.prompt: Aisi misal dein jahan program mukhtalif strategies mein badal sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Raasta batane wali app sab se tez, sab se chhota ya toll ke baghair raasta chun sakti hai. Har tareeqa ek strategy hai, aur app baqi code badle baghair in mein badal sakti hai.

items: Strategy: ek kaam ke kai tareeqe; zaroorat ke mutabiq chuno aur aasani se badlo (toolbox).
